headerLines: B. ELE. ENGG. 3RD YR 1ST SEMESTER SUPPLE EXAMINATION, 2017
parts.scriptNote: Use a separate Answer-Script for each part

rows.textLatex: Give a complete circuit of PAL and explain the working principle of each part.
Using a diode-based AND matrix and transistorized OR matrix, draw a complete circuit to implement a full-adder block. Explain your solution.
Draw a macrocell and show how it is used to implement different types of circuits. What are the disadvantages of SRAM based switch?
Describe with neat circuit diagram, the functionality of a commercially available FPGA chip.
How can the different functions be implemented using multiplexer? Draw two commercial models using multiplexers and show how they are used for the purpose.
Write a complete program in VHDL to generate a ROM containing one LUT of triangular wave. Size of the LUT is 8-byte. Show the mathematical expression as well as the resulting data used in LUT.
Write a program in VHDL to implement one 12-bit up/down counter. The counter will be triggered by negative edge of a clock. The downcount command will have higher priority over upcount.

rows.topic: Short Notes (Antifuse, VHDL, FPGA LUT, JTAG)
rows.textLatex:
Write short notes on any TWO of the following:
a) Antifuse;
b) Process flow in VHDL;
c) Look-Up Table in FPGA structure;
d) JTAG Cable.

headerLines: B. ELE. ENGG. 3RD YEAR 1ST SEMESTER (SUPPLEMENTARY) EXAMINATION, 2017
parts.scriptNote: Use a separate Answer-Script for each part
parts.instructions: Answer any three. Two marks reserved for neatness.

rows.textLatex: Write the mnemonics of various rotate instructions available in context with the programming of 8051. Explain each of them along with appropriate examples.

Explain the operation of following instructions:
i) JBC 03H, 04H      ii) CJNE @R0, 05H, 06H
iii) DJNZ 08H, 09H      iv) MUL AB
Write a program to generate a square wave of $1\text{ kHz}$ frequency at pin P2.3 of 8051 on crystal frequency of $11.0592\text{ MHz}$.

Write a program to implement the following function:
$$y(x) = 3x^2 + 5x, \quad 0 \le x \le 5$$
Input $x$ is received from port-3 and the output $y$ is delivered to port-1.

Write short notes on any two:
a) Ports of 8051.
b) Modes of Timer in 8051.
c) Activation of Interrupts in 8051.

rows.topic: 8051 Special Function Registers (TCON, PSW, IE, SCON)
rows.textLatex:
Write the bit formats of following SFRs and mention in short their functions:
a) TCON      b) PSW      c) IE      d) SCON
